visual.general_description: Four-facet boxplot figure of lower and upper stimulation levels (charge) over time points for Patients 1 to 4.
visual.detailed_description: Four facets arranged in a two-by-two grid, each headed with a grey strip reading Patient 1, Patient 2, Patient 3 or Patient 4. Each facet plots light blue (lower) and dark blue (upper) boxplots with jittered dots per electrode and a red diamond marking each median, joined by lines across categorical time points. The shared y-axis title reads Charge (nC/phase). Patient 1 and Patient 2 facets have time points SO, 2P, 1W, 2M, 1Y, PreB, PostB; Patient 3 has 2P, 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y, PreB, PostB; Patient 4 has Hist and PreB. A pink vertical band marks the PreB position in every facet. In Patient 1, both median lines rise from SO to PreB and both drop at PostB. In Patient 2, the upper median line is highest at PreB and lower at PostB, and the lower median line is lowest at PostB. In Patient 3, both median lines are highest at PreB and lower at PostB, with a wide light blue box at PostB. In Patient 4, both median lines rise from Hist to PreB and the upper series has outlying dots near the top of the axis. The legend headed Stimulation Levels sits inside the Patient 1 facet.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1
Lower and upper stimulation levels at different time points in the implantation pathway. Each dot represents a stimulation level for a given electrode. Boxplots represent the interquartile range; whiskers represent the range between the maximum and minimum values that are not considered outliers. Medians are represented by horizontal lines within each boxplot, but have also been marked with a red diamond. Medians for lower levels and upper stimulation levels measured along time are joined by lines to facilitate the visualisation of changes over time. The pink-shaded area highlights the stimulation levels measured at the prebreak appointment. 1M indicates 1 month after SO; 1W, 1 week after SO; 1Y, 1 year; 2M, 2 months after SO; 2P, second programming appointment; 3M, 3 months after SO; Hist, historical (early pathway data is not appropriate for comparison); PostB, first appointment after taking a break from stimulation; PreB, last appointment before taking a break from stimulation; SO, switch-on.

assignments.rationale: Whole unlettered figure; the printed facet headings Patient 1 to Patient 4 and the caption describing stimulation levels across the implantation pathway tie it to the four reported patients without any identity inference from appearance.

visual.general_description: Two-facet boxplot figure of aided sound field thresholds by frequency over time points for Patients 1 and 2.
visual.detailed_description: Two facets headed Patient 1 and Patient 2 share one y-axis titled Sound Field Aided Thresholds dB(HL) with ticks from 30 to 80. Each facet has grey boxplots at Early pathway, Pre-Break, Post-Break and Latest with colored jittered dots and a red diamond for each median joined by a blue line. A legend headed Frequency (Hz) lists colors for 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 6000 and 8000. In Patient 1 the median diamonds sit near 45 at Early pathway and at about 50 at the other three time points; one orange dot lies near 80 at Pre-Break and one red dot near 32 at Latest. In Patient 2 the median line rises from near 25 at Early pathway to near 45 at Post-Break and then falls to near 35 at Latest.

visual.general_description: Three-facet boxplot figure of long-term lower and upper stimulation levels for Patients 1 to 3 across post-break time points.
visual.detailed_description: Three stacked facets with grey strips on the right edge reading Patient 1, Patient 2 and Patient 3 share one x-axis with categorical labels PreB, PostB, 1, 3, 6, 10, 11, 12, 17, 38, 41, 42, 45, 49, 142, 145 and a y-axis titled Charge (nC/phase). Light blue (lower) and dark blue (upper) boxplots with red median diamonds are joined by lines. Patient 1 has boxes at PreB, PostB, 3, 6 and 12 only, with both lines dropping sharply from PreB to PostB and the upper line then flat near the right. Patient 2 has boxes at PreB, PostB, 1, 11, 17 and 42, with the upper line lower at PostB and higher at 17 and 42. Patient 3 has boxes at PreB, PostB, 10, 38, 41, 45, 49, 142 and 145, with lines that fall from PreB to PostB, rise by 10 and vary thereafter. The legend headed Stimulation Levels sits in the upper right of the Patient 1 facet.

visual.general_description: Scatter-and-line plot of charge by electrode number before and after the break, with open triangles at some electrodes.
visual.detailed_description: A single plot with Electrode number on the x-axis in descending order from 22 on the left to 3 on the right and charge (nC/phase) on the y-axis with ticks 20, 40, 60 and 80. A legend headed Time point shows a blue line with dot and triangle for Pre-break and a red line with dot and triangle for Post-break. Blue filled dots joined by a line run from electrode 18 to electrode 4, and red filled dots joined by a line run from electrode 19 to electrode 3; both rise steeply toward the right, with the highest red dot and a red triangle at electrode 3 at the top of the plot and no blue point at electrode 3. Open blue triangles appear at electrodes 22, 21, 19, 18, 17 and 16, and open red triangles at electrodes 22, 21, 20, 18, 15, 14 and 3. The red line lies below the blue line at electrodes 13 to 9, 6 and 4, meets it near electrodes 16, 8 and 5, and lies slightly above it at electrode 7.

evidence.quote:
Figure 4
Facial-nerve stimulation thresholds (points) before the break (blue) and after the break (red) for Patient 4. Charge levels corresponding to a loudness rating of “loud” are denoted by triangles and were obtained at some electrodes only before the break (blue) and after the break (red). All measurements were carried out using a Pseudomonopolar grounding mode, a 150 µs pulse duration, and a pulse rate of 210 to 245 pps.
